view.title: Photo intake
view.subtitle: Snap a photo, AI suggests a category, the user confirms. Prompt changes are checked on confirmed cases first.
view.loadFailed: Couldn't load. Hit Refresh to try again.
create.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Big photos are shrunk automatically.
create.photoInvalid: Can't read this file. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
create.failed: Couldn't save. Your photo and description are still here; try again.
common.actionFailed: Couldn't save. What you entered is still here. Refresh to see the latest, then try again.
setup.heading: Try a new prompt
setup.title: Run name
setup.defaultB: Inspect visible objects and damage before selecting a category. Distinguish water-related damage from surface damage. Do not infer faults that cannot be seen. Choose unclear if evidence is insufficient.
setup.modelHint: Both use the default primary model, fixed on the first run. Each call sends only the prompt, the category list and the photo, so the model needs to handle images.
setup.noSamples: No confirmed cases yet. Confirm a few under Intake first.
setup.calls: Running this makes {{count}} image-model calls, plus the chat AI's own calls. Saving doesn't call anything.
setup.failed: Couldn't create the run. Check that every selected case is confirmed and no two photos are the same, then try again.
run.configHint: Prompts and confirmed categories are fixed when the run is created. The model is fixed on the first call.
run.settings: Request settings: temperature 0, up to 512 output tokens, no automatic retries. Not every provider honours all of these. Each call is sent on its own, with no chat history.
run.modelPending: Default primary model, picked when the run starts
run.running: Working through the photos one by one. Each result is saved as it finishes.
run.message: Run acceptance run {{id}}: work through the remaining {{count}} items one at a time with photo_intake_evaluate_next, and keep going while status is ready and pending is above 0. Stop if a tool errors. Don't retry failed items yourself, and don't decide which version to adopt for me.
run.sent: Sent to the AI. Results refresh on their own. If the chat stops partway, hit Run remaining to pick it up.
run.sendFailed: Couldn't send. You can ask the AI in chat to carry on with acceptance run {{id}}.
run.empty: No acceptance runs yet. Confirm a few cases, then start one.
metrics.heading: Results
metrics.note: Each photo counts its latest attempt. Failures stay in the total, and timings include failed calls. With this few samples, treat the numbers as a rough guide. Earlier attempts are kept.
result.heading: Photo by photo
result.showDifferences: Only where versions differ or miss
result.noDifferences: Both versions agree, and both match the confirmed categories.
result.evidenceHint: Raw output and every attempt are kept. Your review doesn't change the numbers above.
review.heading: Your review
decision.heading: Decision
decision.hint: After looking at the comparison, write down your decision and why. A version with failed items can't be adopted. If you adopt A or B, recognition uses that prompt from now on; the model stays the same.
decision.wait: Finish the remaining items before deciding.
result.truncated: The output was too long. Only the first 65,536 characters were kept, and this item counts as malformed.
run.unavailable: Can't find this run. Go back to the list or refresh.
create.heading: New case
create.title: Description
create.titleHint: One line: where it is and what you saw. The description isn't sent to the recognition model.
cases.heading: Cases
cases.empty: No cases yet. Add a photo and a one-line description to create one.
cases.title: Description
cases.agreement: Of the recently confirmed cases with an AI suggestion, {{agreed}} of {{total}} matched it.
case.dialogHint: AI only suggests. You pick the category.
case.unavailable: Can't find this case. Close this and refresh the list.
case.noPhoto: This case's photo is missing, so it can't be recognised. You can still pick a category and confirm.
case.analyzing: AI is looking at the photo. The result will show up here.
case.message: Recognise intake case {{id}}: call photo_intake_analyze_case once, then tell me the suggested category and why. Don't confirm the category for me. If the tool fails, tell me why and stop.
case.sent: Sent to the AI. The result will show up here.
case.sendFailed: Couldn't send. You can ask the AI in chat to recognise case {{id}}.
case.failed: Recognition failed: {{reason}}. Try again, or just confirm a category yourself.
case.confirmHint: Once confirmed, this case is final and can be used to try out prompts.
case.confirmedWithoutSuggestion: Confirmed before there was a suggestion.
case.conflict: This case was just changed and has been refreshed. Check it, then confirm again.
failure.model_call_failed: Model call failed. Check the provider connection and whether the model can read images
failure.invalid_output: Output wasn't valid JSON, or the category isn't on the list
failure.photo_missing: The stored photo can't be read or has changed
failure.interrupted: Call was interrupted; its result wasn't used
setup.intro: Run the new prompt and the current one on cases you've confirmed, then decide whether to switch.
run.active: {{version}} from this run is now used for recognition.
result.photoLoadFailed: Couldn't load the photo. Close this and try again.
